animestack-house.name: AnimeStack House - the room
animestack-house.description: The AnimeStack house on the declared subagent surface: spawns the eight seats as subagents, runs the two rounds, and lets Reika sign. Use when the Agent Teams surface is absent or the work is a plain room.

animestack-team.name: AnimeStack Team - the Agent Teams chair
animestack-team.description: The AnimeStack house on the Agent Teams surface: the lead seat frames the brief, spawns the seven answering seats as durable teammates, runs the takes and the exchange, and Reika signs the close. Requires the Agent Teams profile bundle.

animestack-mei.name: AnimeStack Mei - Keeper of Climate & Context
animestack-mei.description: The Mei seat of the AnimeStack house: What change in the world makes this obsolete?. One sentence, one close, one lane - review and build, never the room.
